items.title: Security practices and reporting a vulnerability
items.body:
This article explains security practices and reporting a vulnerability: we never ask for passwords, phishing reports, security@ address, 2FA.

## Key facts

- Security: Acme staff never ask for passwords or full card numbers. 2FA via authenticator app.
- A failed payment is retried on days 1, 3 and 7. After the third failure the account becomes read-only ("suspended"); updating the card and paying restores it instantly. Data is never deleted because of a failed payment.
- Vulnerabilities: security@acmecloud.example. Account owner changes require the current owner's confirmation, or ID verification if the owner has left.

## We never ask for passwords
